title: Blizzard Unleashed a Zombie Plague on WoW on Purpose in 2008
hook: In October 2008 Blizzard turned Stormwind into a zombie outbreak on purpose, then pulled the plug after about six days when the forums melted down. Would you have joined the undead or logged off?
script: Did you know Blizzard once unleashed a zombie plague on World of Warcraft on purpose, and then had to shut it down early? It happened in late October of two thousand eight, in the weeks before Wrath of the Lich King came out. Strange crates started showing up in Booty Bay. Anyone who touched one caught a disease with a countdown timer. If the timer ran out, your character turned into a zombie, and you could infect other players and NPCs. At first you had minutes to find a cure. Blizzard kept shrinking that window until it was down to two minutes. Then packs of zombies started taking over the capital cities. Auctioneers, trainers and vendors in Stormwind were killed, and the economy ground to a halt. The whole point was to make you hate the Lich King before the expansion launched. Plenty of players loved the chaos. Plenty of others flooded the forums, because they could not quest, trade or play normally. After about a week, on October twenty seventh, a cure arrived and the plague ended. Unlike the accidental Corrupted Blood outbreak three years earlier, this one was designed by Blizzard from the start. It is still one of the most talked about pre expansion events the game has ever had. Follow for more gaming history.
